svg.title: Validation-only K-ary scaling
svg.desc: Matched-row comparison of binary, four-way, and eight-way recursive mergers with 768-token leaves. K=4 improves depth and throughput over K=2 on this cache, while K=8 is more detectable and was rejected by the training saturation guard.
